headline: CLR-Bench tests whether self-evolving agents infer hidden rules from feedback
summary: The 29 October arXiv preprint introduces CLR-Bench, a benchmark of 20 four-level curriculum chains across 10 constructed domains. It tests whether six self-evolution methods infer hidden named groupings from sparse feedback and transfer them to unseen values, rather than retaining corrections as exceptions. The authors report weak feedback-only generalization for GPT-6-Luna, improvement with a fixed lesson, and substantially stronger results for selected methods with GPT-6-Sol. These are author-reported results on a small constructed benchmark; they do not establish general agent learning or operational transfer.
